Start with the reader's question or problem. Give only the context they need to continue.

## What to know

Explain the essential idea in clear, public language. Define unfamiliar open source terms.

## What to do

1. Start with the smallest useful action
2. Explain how to check the result
3. Show where to ask for help

## What this does not tell us

State important limits, uncertainty, scope or freshness. Link to approved public evidence with descriptive text.

## Take the next step

End with one realistic next action and an approved public destination.
